typography.instructions: Use Inter (500/600/700) from Google Fonts for UI; IBM Plex Mono for IoCs, IDs, metrics.

colors.guidelines: Single blue accent only. No purple brand, no neon cyan, no glow shadows, no AI gradients. Severity colors must stay consistent across tables, badges, charts, heatmap, and timelines. Prefer CSS variables in index.css and design-system/tokens.js.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: 1px borders with subtle elevation (shadow-sm). Cards radius 12px; buttons/inputs 8px.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Never use glowing shadows or neon borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: No scanlines. Optional soft navy radial on login brand panel only.

layouts.dashboard_grid: KPI row + charts + recent table + ATT&CK heatmap. Dense but readable.
layouts.density: Comfortable default; tables use sticky headers and row hover.

components.kpi_cards: soc-card, subtle border, token severity tones, no hover lift.
components.hitl_approval_gate: warning semantic border and badge; no neon pulse.
components.ai_surfaces: Recommendation panels (confidence, evidence, MITRE, SOC actions) — not chat-product chrome.
components.tooltips: PREREQUISITE: every page/panel/KPI/action ships HelpTip or Tip by default via design-system props (tipTitle/tipBody, PaneLabel, DsButton tooltip=). See docs/dx/TOOLTIP_PREREQUISITE.md. Never ship UI with 'tooltips later'.

defaults.DsButton: tooltip= wraps Tip; requireTooltip for icon-only

tooltip_prerequisite.dev_behavior: console.warn once per missing surface in DEV

icons.instruction: Keep Phosphor only; do not mix Lucide/Heroicons. Consistent weight regular/bold.

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA for text on surfaces

instructions_to_main_agent: Never reintroduce cyan/violet neon brand accents.
Use design-system tokens for charts (SEVERITY_HEX, colors.chart).
Preserve all business logic, APIs, workflows, and testids.
AI Investigator should look like analyst assist panels, not ChatGPT.
